mapper.select: select u.* from jsh_unit u left join jsh_material m on u.name = m.unit and ifnull(m.delete_flag,'0') !='1' where m.id = #{mId} and ifnull(u.delete_flag,'0') !='1'
select m.*,u.name unit_name from jsh_material m left join jsh_unit u on u.name = m.unit and ifnull(u.delete_flag,'0') !='1' where m.id = #{id} and ifnull(m.delete_flag,'0') !='1'

select m.*,u.name unit_name,m.bar_code m_bar_code, m.unit, me.purchase_decimal, me.commodity_decimal, me.wholesale_decimal, me.low_decimal, me.img_url as imgName from jsh_material m left join jsh_material_extend me on m.id=me.material_id and ifnull(me.delete_Flag,'0') !='1' left join jsh_unit u on u.name = m.unit and ifnull(u.delete_Flag,'0') !='1' where me.id = #{meId} and ifnull(m.delete_flag,'0') !='1'

select m.bar_code, m.name, m.mnemonic, m.unit unit from jsh_material m left join jsh_material_extend me on m.id = me.material_id and ifnull(me.delete_Flag,'0') !='1' where me.id is not null
and (m.bar_code like #{bindKey} or m.name like #{bindKey} or m.mnemonic like #{bindKey})
and ifnull(m.delete_flag,'0') !='1' order by m.id desc, me.default_flag desc, me.id asc limit 0,20

select me.material_id, m.bar_code, m.unit commodity_unit from jsh_material_extend me join jsh_material m on m.id = me.material_id and ifnull(m.delete_flag,'0') !='1' where me.default_flag=0 and (me.spec_values='' or me.spec_values is null) and ifnull(me.delete_Flag,'0') !='1' group by me.material_id, m.bar_code, m.unit

select m.*,m.bar_code m_bar_code from jsh_material m left join jsh_material_extend me on m.id=me.material_id and ifnull(me.delete_Flag,'0') !='1' where 1=1 and m.enable_serial_number ='1'
and (m.bar_code like #{bindKey} or m.name like #{bindKey})
and ifnull(m.delete_flag,'0') !='1' order by m.id desc
limit #{offset},#{rows}

select count(me.id) from jsh_material m left join jsh_material_extend me on m.id=me.material_id and ifnull(me.delete_Flag,'0') !='1' where 1=1 and m.enable_serial_number ='1'
and (m.bar_code like #{bindKey} or m.name like #{bindKey})
and ifnull(m.delete_flag,'0') !='1'
select m.bar_code from jsh_material m where ifnull(m.delete_flag,'0') !='1' and ifnull(m.bar_code,'') !=''
select m.name from jsh_material m where m.name is not null and m.name !='' and ifnull(m.delete_flag,'0') !='1' group by m.name order by m.name asc

select material_id, ifnull(sum(mis.number),0) number from jsh_material_initial_stock mis where 1=1
and mis.depot_id in
#{item}
group by mis.material_id

select stock_rows.* from ( select m.*, u.name unitName, u.ratio, mc.name categoryName, me.id meId, coalesce(nullif(me.sku_code,''), nullif(m.bar_code,''), m.bar_code) mBarCode, me.spec_values sku, me.sku_code skuCode, me.spec_values specValues, me.img_url imgName, ifnull(me.purchase_decimal,0) purchaseDecimal, (select max(mcs.current_unit_price) from jsh_material_current_stock mcs where mcs.material_id=m.id and (mcs.material_extend_id=me.id or (mcs.material_extend_id is null and me.default_flag=1)) and ifnull(mcs.delete_flag,'0')!='1'
and mcs.depot_id in #{depotId} ) currentUnitPrice, ifnull((select sum(mcs.current_number) from jsh_material_current_stock mcs where mcs.material_id=m.id and (mcs.material_extend_id=me.id or (mcs.material_extend_id is null and me.default_flag=1)) and ifnull(mcs.delete_flag,'0')!='1'
and mcs.depot_id in #{depotId} ),0) currentStock, ifnull((select sum(mis.number) from jsh_material_initial_stock mis where mis.material_id=m.id and (mis.material_extend_id=me.id or (mis.material_extend_id is null and me.default_flag=1)) and ifnull(mis.delete_flag,'0')!='1'
and mis.depot_id in #{depotId} ),0) initialStock, ifnull(me.purchase_decimal,0) * ifnull((select sum(mcs.current_number) from jsh_material_current_stock mcs where mcs.material_id=m.id and (mcs.material_extend_id=me.id or (mcs.material_extend_id is null and me.default_flag=1)) and ifnull(mcs.delete_flag,'0')!='1'
and mcs.depot_id in #{depotId} ),0) currentStockPrice, ifnull((select sum(mcs.current_unit_price * mcs.current_number) from jsh_material_current_stock mcs where mcs.material_id=m.id and (mcs.material_extend_id=me.id or (mcs.material_extend_id is null and me.default_flag=1)) and ifnull(mcs.delete_flag,'0')!='1'
and mcs.depot_id in #{depotId} ),0) currentStockMovePrice, ifnull(m.weight,0) * ifnull((select sum(mcs.current_number) from jsh_material_current_stock mcs where mcs.material_id=m.id and (mcs.material_extend_id=me.id or (mcs.material_extend_id is null and me.default_flag=1)) and ifnull(mcs.delete_flag,'0')!='1'
and mcs.depot_id in #{depotId} ),0) currentWeight from jsh_material m join jsh_material_extend me on me.material_id=m.id and ifnull(me.delete_flag,'0')!='1' left join jsh_unit u on u.name = m.unit and ifnull(u.delete_flag,'0')!='1' left join jsh_material_category mc on m.category_id=mc.id and ifnull(mc.delete_flag,'0')!='1' where ifnull(m.delete_flag,'0')!='1'
and m.category_id in #{id}
and m.position like concat('%',#{position},'%')
and (m.bar_code like concat('%',#{materialParam},'%') or me.sku_code like concat('%',#{materialParam},'%') or me.spec_values like concat('%',#{materialParam},'%') or m.bar_code like concat('%',#{materialParam},'%') or m.name like concat('%',#{materialParam},'%') or m.mnemonic like concat('%',#{materialParam},'%') or m.brand like concat('%',#{materialParam},'%') or m.mfrs like concat('%',#{materialParam},'%') or m.other_field1 like concat('%',#{materialParam},'%') or m.other_field2 like concat('%',#{materialParam},'%') or m.other_field3 like concat('%',#{materialParam},'%') or m.other_field4 like concat('%',#{materialParam},'%') or m.other_field5 like concat('%',#{materialParam},'%') or m.other_field6 like concat('%',#{materialParam},'%') or m.other_field7 like concat('%',#{materialParam},'%'))
) stock_rows where ifnull(stock_rows.currentStock,0)!=0 order by
stock_rows.mBarCode stock_rows.purchaseDecimal stock_rows.currentStock stock_rows.currentStockPrice stock_rows.currentWeight stock_rows.id
ascdesc, stock_rows.id desc, stock_rows.meId asc limit #{offset}, #{rows}
